mapper.insert: insert into batch.alert_event ( tenant_id, service_name, alert_type, severity, title, detail_json, dedup_fingerprint, trace_id, status ) values ( #{entity.tenantId}, #{entity.serviceName}, #{entity.alertType}, #{entity.severity}, #{entity.title}, CAST(#{entity.detailJson} AS jsonb), #{entity.dedupFingerprint}, #{entity.traceId}, coalesce(#{entity.status}, #{defaultStatus}) ) on conflict (tenant_id, dedup_fingerprint) do update set title = excluded.title, detail_json = excluded.detail_json, trace_id = excluded.trace_id, occurrence_count = batch.alert_event.occurrence_count + 1, last_seen_at = current_timestamp, updated_at = current_timestamp
